_doc: All versions (Emerald v1.1 list 2026-10-18; Sapphire/Ruby the same day, user: do the optional fixes): Black 2's battle text (system 0019, the battle's own messages, and its twin 0017 that one battle mode reads) ends every trainer battle with the literal word "Player" ("Player defeated\nYoungster Tommy!": the battle registers only the opponent's class and name for these lines, never the player's name). Ours say "You" there, as the same file's "You are challenged by" (line 7). patches/exp_share.py repacks these files and merges these lines too.
